integrity: All formulas refer to the fixed Hata affine map with selection bias, not to geometric deformation of the maps. New algebraic and Monte Carlo checks supplement, but cannot substitute for, the proof. No assertion of priority or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Annealed law; exact generating function and excursion count require uniform initial distribution on the disfavored half and iid selection. Endpoint law holds for absolutely continuous initial distributions; no quenched or finite-horizon process limit. Equivalent unindexed derivations remain possible.
title: Biased Hata maps: exact excursion counts, occupation transform, and critical crossover
